ns2:Work.dc:title: Box - ABox
ns2:Work.dc:description:
A simple Box
This box is kept simple on purpose. If you need more features have a look at the UniversalBox.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes ABox --thickness=3.0 --burn=0.15 --x=220 --y=160 --h=50 --outside=1 --format=svg Command line short: boxes ABox --burn=0.15 --x=220 --y=160 --h=50

text.style: font-family: sans-serif ; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; fill: rgb(255,0,0)
